observations.body: The signed-out Login page offers Username and Password fields and a Sign in button; it lists emily.dawson as the Employee demo account.
Login is signed out with Employee username available and the Sign in control ready.
Submitting the configured Employee credentials signed in and displayed the employee dashboard.
Employee Dashboard shows leave balance loading, zero pending leave requests, navigation to Directory, My Leave, Timesheet and My Profile, quick links to Request leave and Fill timesheet, and Log out.
My Leave offers New request, shows an available balance of 18 days, and lists an approved three-day Vacation request for Aug 18–19, 2026 with manager comment “Approved – enjoy!”.

New Leave Request offers Vacation, Sick, and Personal leave types; required Start date and End date fields; an optional Reason field; Submit request and Cancel. It states weekends are not counted toward leave.
New Leave Request is ready with the Employee’s 18-day balance; the planned evaluation data is a Vacation request for Oct 1–2, 2026 with reason “Evaluation data”.
Submitting with blank Start date and End date showed “Please fill in all required fields.” and stayed on New Leave Request; no leave request was created.
Timesheet shows a draft for the week of Sep 14, 2026 with seven daily hour inputs all at 0, total 0 h, plus Save draft and Submit week.
The Sep 14, 2026 draft has 0 total hours and Submit week is ready for an empty-submission validation check.

Submitting the zero-hour Sep 14, 2026 timesheet succeeded, marked it submitted, disabled all inputs and Save draft/Submit week, and showed “Timesheet submitted.” This submitted record is evaluation data.
My Profile offers Upload photo, editable Full name, Phone, and Emergency contact fields, a disabled read-only Email field, and Save changes. It displays Emily Dawson’s profile details.

Employee Directory offers name search, an All departments filter with Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and HR options, name sorting, and pagination. It reports 28 employees across 3 pages; page 1 shows employee names, departments, titles, and email addresses.
